interpretation: All three declared20-segment profiles (1000,10000,50000 books) completed all five distinct-process phases; the largest traversed1,000,000 results in3508.494986251s with no loss/duplicates, then completed fresh-process restart,12 public import/retry samples,actual cancellation/retained-source recovery,backup/verify/restore.
The50000x20 measurement phase used3563.203822906s of the declared3600-second allowance. Its exact workload remains page37,segment256B; this is not a different page100 workload.

The separate50000x40 profile built/audited2,000,000 actual segments, then measurement returned PARTIAL/BudgetExceeded after3600.365813707s. Only progress.phase=measure and empty stdout/stderr were retained; precise substage/message were not recorded.
Deadline attribution for the two-million-segment profile is an inference from its declared allowance and observed wall time. No timeout or page-size change is made by this evidence inspection.

Fixture construction is not sustained ordinary ingestion. Public operation samples, independent phase processes and supervising-process RSS are separately reported. Worker peak memory,Windows,physical/NVDA,power-loss,real-world diversity and general release readiness are not qualified.
The new call-local literal candidate-work optimization is separate STATIC_NOT_RUN source and is not part of any of these original C3 measurements.
